gen-tourney-gf-radio-canada: Tourney is all stretched-out, bulky letters cut at a single width. Radio Canada then settles into tall, full-bodied lowercase and a steady line, so paragraphs of it glide along with curves that stay clearly open.
gen-tourney-gf-radio-canada-big: Wide-tracked and thick-set, Tourney hits like a starting whistle. Radio Canada Big has an x-height that fills the line, so its size can be dialed down a notch without losing its footing.
gen-tourney-gf-readex-pro: Readex Pro keeps a steady weight, with broad gaps at the terminals. What stands out is the gap to Tourney, whose bulky, stretched, single-width letters make the sans below feel quietly measured.
gen-tourney-gf-roboto: Roboto's round letters have generous mouths, and its capitals sit close to the lowercase in height. Tourney, though, is monoline throughout and stretched wide, which gives the sans-serif body something loud to push against.
gen-tourney-gf-ruda: Chunky and stretched, Tourney arrives at full volume with one-width strokes. Ruda, the plain sans here, with a sizable x-height and wire-thin monoline strokes, keeps paragraphs light and approachable from line to line.
gen-tourney-gf-saira: The body text reads cleanly, every s open to the light and the round letters stretching high. Saira sits beside the loud, stretched Tourney as a quiet neighbor, both without calligraphic shading to steer the eye.
gen-tourney-gf-sarpanch: Bent-pipe-cleaner lines, stretched wide and bulky: that is Tourney. Sarpanch steps in with a clearly open e and a compact reach to the ascender line, giving that shouty heading a tidy, approachable partner.
gen-tourney-gf-savate: Savate has sturdy hairlines, open jaws on its curves, and a tall round o that nearly matches the capital. But beneath Tourney, with its zero-modulation strokes, this sans carries paragraphs gently on a quiet contrast.
gen-tourney-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Schibsted Grotesk has big, open-looking e and a with tall bowls, and terminals that never close in. Beside the neon-tube strokes of Tourney, the body can stay modest in size.
gen-tourney-gf-sen: Tourney stretches each word wide through generous tracking. Sen, the plain sans below, builds tall lowercase on a constant-weight line, and that quiet tidiness beside such bulk is the pair's whole appeal.
